sequence.description: Test whether SAML assertion replay protection is incorrectly scoped to the IdP alias (provider instance) rather than the realm/broker context, by replaying the same Assertion/@ID through two different SAML IdP instances that point to the same upstream IdP.

Implication: Flow coherence broken: SAML login completed successfully using a flow started before client flow-binding change (stale FSM / step-skipping).

sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: If the client authentication flow binding is changed between SP-initiated start and SAMLResponse consumption, the completion must follow the updated FSM (or be rejected), not the stale pre-change flow.

sequence.description: I5: SAML assertion without <Conditions> should be rejected; if accepted, broker may ignore upstream intent constraints (audience/time) and issue tokens usable for authorization evaluation.
